name: Cross-asset contagion — BTC crowd spike AND the alt's own attention turning up (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: the contagion pulse (btc_social_accel spike → risk-on rotation into alts within a day) but only on alts that are ALSO catching their own fresh attention (social_volume_accel positive). The dual gate distinguishes alts that are actually receiving the rotating flow from ones that merely have beta to BTC — the alt-specific attention onset is the routing signal for WHERE the risk-on capital lands. Counterparty is late-repricing alt holders. DISCONFIRMER: regress out contemporaneous BTC return AND the alt's own price momentum; if the combined signal is just lagged beta plus own-price autocorrelation, KILL. Shuffle both attention series independently; the joint effect must collapse. Must clear 4h fees.
catalyst: BTC crowd spike landing on an alt that is itself catching attention
